title: calceolaria llamaensis
intro: Calceolaria llamaensis, commonly known as the Andean slipper, is a flowering plant species native to the high-altitude regions of South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calceolaria llamaensis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
